top_signals.title: Ex-cost of living adviser Richard Walker demands ‘aggressive’ tax reform
top_signals.summary: Lord Richard Walker, the Iceland boss who advised the Sir Keir Starmer government on the cost of living, has called on Andy Burnham and John Healey to unleash “aggressive” tax reform to encourage firms to invest and hire more young people.  In a paper for the Blairite think tank Progress, Walker made a series of [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
